overall_reason: The update changes four update-relevant contracts: (1) auto-leave is now initiated once per joint configuration (edge-triggered, pendingConfIndex advanced to the auto-leave index, nil-Data entry that can never be refused); (2) the leader refuses conf-change proposals that do not fit the joint state (non-leave while joint, leave while not joint); (3) empty-payload proposals are never dropped by the uncommitted-size quota; (4) a pending leadership transfer is aborted when the transferee is demoted, not only removed. The old AutoLeaveAdvance demands repeated auto-leave and admits a quota-retry branch, ProposalConfigurationDecisions/OutcomeSoundness demand acceptance (or quota drop) that the new requirement forbids, ConfigurationTransitionSafety is blind to auto-leave entries, and no property observes the transfer/demotion rule. All other properties (including watch-touched ones) still express the needed contract and are kept; several observer fields must be migrated. The old AutoLeaveAdvance eligibility must not be narrowed to the new edge trigger because the new code appears to miss auto-leave for a freshly elected leader whose log is fully applied.
